issues.where: crop 5, the near flakes in front of the pond and snowy bank
issues.what: A cluster of similarly sized, uniformly cream-colored circles reads as a separate overlay across the lower scene. The finer flakes do vary in size and focus, but the foreground cluster repeatedly uses the same soft disc shape.
issues.fix: Break up the cluster with irregular crystals and clumps, a wider range of blur and opacity, and a less even distribution across the pond.

issues.where: crops 3 and 5, the lower front of the globe between the pond and the collar
issues.what: The snow beneath the pond becomes a broad opaque gray band with a clean cutoff at the collar. There is little visible separation between the landform, the liquid and the outer pane, so they read as one solid bowl.
issues.fix: Keep the snowy bank but separate it from the pane with a narrow refracted edge, a more gradual frost transition and an inner glass reflection above the collar.

issues.where: crops 7 and 8, the white frost fanning out to the right of the foot
issues.what: The large feather-shaped frost has solid white centers and hard, flat edges against the wet surface. It looks printed onto the tabletop rather than grown on it.
issues.fix: Break the fan into translucent crystalline branches and finer grains. Thin it toward its tips and carry small wet highlights between the branches so it belongs to the same surface as the slush around the foot.
